title: AWS Core Services Flashcards
description: Comprehensive flashcard deck of the 60 most popular and widely used Amazon Web Services (AWS) worldwide.

cards.description: Secure and resizable virtual compute capacity in the cloud. Allows users to launch virtual servers (instances) on-demand with customizable CPU, memory, storage, and networking.
use_cases: Hosting web applications and backend APIs
Running high-performance computing (HPC) simulations
Deploying legacy enterprise applications in the cloud

cards.description: Scalable object storage service offering 99.999999999% (11 9s) of data durability. Stores and retrieves any amount of data from anywhere over the internet.
use_cases: Hosting static websites and assets (HTML, CSS, JS, images)
Data lake storage for big data analytics
Backup, archiving, and disaster recovery data storage

cards.description: Managed relational database service that simplifies setup, operation, and scaling of database engines including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL Server.
use_cases: Transactional relational databases for e-commerce platforms
Enterprise ERP and CRM database backends
Multi-AZ failover configurations for high-availability production workloads

cards.description: Web service that enables secure management of access to AWS services and resources. Allows creation of users, groups, roles, and granular permission policies.
use_cases: Enforcing least-privilege access control for development teams
Granting temporary AWS credentials to EC2 instances and Lambda functions via IAM roles
Configuring multi-factor authentication (MFA) for administrative root and user access

cards.description: Logically isolated virtual network within AWS where you launch AWS resources. Provides complete control over IP address ranges, subnets, route tables, and network gateways.
use_cases: Isolating multi-tier web applications into public and private subnets
Establishing secure private connections to on-premises data centers via VPN or Direct Connect
Securing backend database tiers with private subnets and security groups

cards.description: Serverless event-driven compute service that lets you run code without provisioning or managing servers. Automatically scales from a few requests per day to thousands per second.
use_cases: Real-time file processing upon upload to S3 (image resizing, metadata extraction)
Serverless REST API backends coupled with Amazon API Gateway
Automated scheduled administrative tasks via EventBridge triggers

cards.description: Fully managed, serverless, key-value and document NoSQL database designed for single-digit millisecond latency performance at any scale.
use_cases: High-traffic user session stores and shopping cart state management
Gaming leaderboards and real-time player telemetry
High-throughput IoT device data collection and telemetry caching

cards.description: Fast, secure Content Delivery Network (CDN) service that globally delivers data, videos, applications, and APIs to users with low latency and high transfer speeds.
use_cases: Accelerating delivery of static and dynamic web content worldwide
Low-latency video streaming (HLS/DASH) at global scale
Edge computing and request security inspection with CloudFront Functions and AWS WAF

cards.description: Fully managed message queuing service that enables decoupling and scaling of microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications.
use_cases: Decoupling frontend order submission from asynchronous backend order processing
Buffering sudden traffic spikes to protect downstream databases and services
Implementing FIFO queues for strictly ordered financial and transactional tasks

cards.description: Fully managed pub/sub messaging service for high-throughput, push-based many-to-many messaging between distributed systems and end-user notifications.
use_cases: Fanout architecture broadcasting messages simultaneously to multiple SQS queues
Sending automated SMS, push notifications, and email alerts to mobile users
Publishing critical system alerts triggered by Amazon CloudWatch alarms

cards.description: Highly scalable and fast container management service that makes it easy to run, stop, and manage Docker containers on a cluster using EC2 or AWS Fargate.
use_cases: Running containerized microservices architectures with deep AWS integrations
Executing containerized batch processing jobs with AWS Batch
Simplifying legacy monolithic application container migrations

cards.description: Managed Kubernetes service to run Kubernetes on AWS and on-premises without needing to install and operate your own Kubernetes control plane or nodes.
use_cases: Deploying enterprise cloud-native Kubernetes workloads with standard open-source tooling
Hybrid cloud deployments consistent across AWS and on-premises environments
Running large-scale distributed AI/ML training clusters on Kubernetes

cards.description: Fully managed container image registry making it easy for developers to store, manage, share, and deploy Docker container images securely.
use_cases: Centralized private registry for microservice container images across development pipelines
Automated vulnerability scanning of container images on push
Geo-replicated container image caching across multiple AWS regions

cards.description: High-performance block-storage service designed for use with Amazon EC2 for both throughput and transaction-intensive workloads at any scale.
use_cases: Persistent primary boot and data volumes for EC2 virtual instances
High-IOPS storage for self-hosted databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cassandra)
Point-in-time automated volume snapshots stored durably in Amazon S3

cards.description: Simple, serverless, set-and-forget elastic file system allowing shared access to file storage from hundreds of EC2 instances, containers, and Lambda functions concurrently.
use_cases: Shared media and content storage for distributed web content management systems (WordPress, Drupal)
Shared home directories for developer workspaces and data science notebook servers
Multi-container persistent shared file systems in Amazon ECS and EKS

cards.description: Automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets (EC2 instances, containers, IP addresses, and Lambda functions) in one or more Availability Zones.
use_cases: Distributing web traffic across redundant application servers to achieve fault tolerance
Enforcing SSL/TLS termination and certificate management at the network perimeter
Automated health checks routing traffic only to healthy compute targets

cards.description: Layer 7 load balancer that routes HTTP and HTTPS traffic based on advanced request attributes such as URL path, host headers, query parameters, and HTTP methods.
use_cases: Path-based routing directing /api to microservices and /static to frontend clusters
Host-based routing hosting multiple domain names on a single load balancer
Integrating with AWS WAF for real-time application security filtering

cards.description: Ultra high-performance Layer 4 load balancer capable of handling millions of requests per second while maintaining ultra-low latencies and supporting static IP addresses.
use_cases: Load balancing non-HTTP protocols such as TCP, UDP, and TLS connections
High-throughput gaming servers and live streaming protocols
Exposing private services via AWS PrivateLink with static Anycast IP addresses

cards.description: Collection of Amazon EC2 instances treated as a logical grouping for automatic scaling, management, and health replacement according to demand policies.
use_cases: Dynamically scaling EC2 instance fleet up during peak traffic and down during quiet hours
Maintaining a constant minimum fleet size by automatically replacing failed instances
Cost optimization by blending Spot Instances and On-Demand instances

cards.description: Highly available and scalable cloud Domain Name System (DNS) web service designed to route end users to internet applications and manage public/private domain records.
use_cases: Domain registration and DNS record management with 100% availability SLA
Latency-based, geolocation, and weighted DNS routing for multi-region applications
DNS failover routing traffic away from unhealthy endpoints based on health checks

cards.description: Fully managed service that makes it easy for developers to create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure REST, HTTP, and WebSocket APIs at any scale.
use_cases: Serverless REST API frontend proxying requests to AWS Lambda backend functions
Real-time bidirectional communication backends using WebSockets (chat, live notifications)
API monetization with API keys, usage plans, throttling, and OAuth/Cognito authentication

cards.description: Monitoring and observability service built for DevOps engineers, developers, site reliability engineers (SREs), and IT managers to collect metrics, logs, and trace data.
use_cases: Collecting and querying centralized application and system log streams
Triggering automated alarms on high CPU or memory thresholds to activate Auto Scaling
Building real-time operational dashboards for cloud infrastructure health

cards.description: Service that enables governance, compliance, operational auditing, and risk auditing of your AWS account by recording every API call and user action across the account.
use_cases: Security forensics and auditing identifying who made specific resource modifications
Compliance reporting demonstrating regulatory adherence (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA)
Detecting unauthorized or anomalous IAM credential usage patterns

cards.description: Managed service that makes it easy for you to create and control cryptographic keys used to encrypt data across AWS services and within your applications.
use_cases: Server-side encryption for S3 buckets, EBS volumes, RDS databases, and DynamoDB tables
Application-level envelope encryption for sensitive customer PII
Hardware security module (HSM) backed FIPS 140-2 Level 3 key protection

cards.description: Web application firewall that helps protect web applications and APIs from common web exploits (SQL injection, XSS) and bots that could affect availability or compromise security.
use_cases: Blocking SQL injection and Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks on ALB and CloudFront
Rate-limiting malicious IP addresses performing brute-force and DDoS attacks
Enforcing AWS Managed Rules for common CVE vulnerabilities and bot control

cards.description: Service that helps you protect secrets needed to access applications, services, and IT resources. Easily rotate, manage, and retrieve database credentials, API keys, and other secrets.
use_cases: Securely retrieving database passwords in Lambda and EC2 without hardcoding
Automated scheduled rotation of RDS database credentials with zero application downtime
Centrally managing third-party SaaS API keys across multiple microservices

cards.description: Service that lets you easily provision, manage, and deploy public and private SSL/TLS certificates for use with AWS services and internal connected resources.
use_cases: Provisioning free public SSL/TLS certificates for CloudFront distributions and ALBs
Automating annual SSL certificate renewals with zero administrative effort
Issuing private CA certificates for internal microservice-to-microservice mTLS encryption

cards.description: Customer identity and access management (CIAM) service providing user sign-up, sign-in, and access control for web and mobile applications with support for social and enterprise IdPs.
use_cases: User directory management with User Pools for user sign-up and authentication
Federating authentication with Google, Apple, Facebook, and SAML 2.0 / OIDC identity providers
Exchanging identity tokens for temporary scoped AWS credentials via Cognito Identity Pools

cards.description: Intelligent threat detection service that continuously monitors your AWS accounts, workloads, and data for malicious activity and unauthorized behavior using machine learning.
use_cases: Detecting compromised EC2 instances involved in cryptocurrency mining or botnets
Identifying compromised IAM credentials performing anomalous API operations
Monitoring S3 bucket access logs for unusual data exfiltration patterns

cards.description: Cloud security posture management service that aggregates, organizes, and prioritizes security alerts and findings from multiple AWS services and third-party tools.
use_cases: Single pane of glass dashboard for security findings across all AWS accounts
Automated compliance checks against CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark and PCI DSS
Triggering automated remediation workflows via EventBridge on high-severity findings

cards.description: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) service that allows you to model, provision, and manage AWS and third-party resources using declarative JSON or YAML configuration templates.
use_cases: Automating repeatable multi-region infrastructure provisioning through templates
Managing infrastructure lifecycle with change sets, drift detection, and automated rollbacks
Defining complete application stacks in code alongside source repositories

cards.description: Open-source software development framework to define cloud infrastructure in familiar programming languages (TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, Go) which synthesizes into CloudFormation.
use_cases: Writing type-safe infrastructure as code using modern object-oriented patterns
Building reusable organizational infrastructure construct libraries
Simplifying serverless application definitions with high-level L2/L3 constructs

cards.description: Visual serverless workflow orchestration service that lets developers construct multi-step workflows linking distributed services, Lambda functions, and human approvals.
use_cases: Orchestrating multi-step e-commerce checkout workflows with retries and compensation logic
Automating complex ETL data pipelines coordinating Glue, EMR, and Athena
Building long-running business processes requiring manual human review steps

cards.description: Serverless event bus service that makes it easy to connect applications using data from your own applications, integrated SaaS applications, and AWS services.
use_cases: Event-driven microservice decoupling using custom event buses and schema registry
Ingesting and reacting to webhook events from third-party SaaS tools (Datadog, Zendesk, Stripe)
Automating infrastructure reactions to AWS resource state changes

cards.description: Cost-effective, flexible, and scalable email service that enables developers to send transactional, marketing, or mass email communications reliably.
use_cases: Sending automated transactional emails (order confirmations, password reset links)
High-volume marketing newsletters with sender reputation management and bounce tracking
Receiving incoming emails and triggering automated S3 or Lambda processing

cards.description: Fast, fully managed, petabyte-scale cloud data warehouse service that makes it simple and cost-effective to analyze all your data using standard SQL and existing BI tools.
use_cases: Enterprise business intelligence reporting and historical data warehousing
Querying structured and semi-structured data across data lakes with Redshift Spectrum
Real-time operational analytics on streaming data feeds

cards.description: Serverless interactive query service that makes it easy to analyze data in Amazon S3 using standard SQL without needing to set up or manage infrastructure.
use_cases: Ad-hoc SQL querying of VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail audit logs, and ALB access logs in S3
Running quick analytical queries on S3 data lakes without provisioning data warehouses
Querying geospatial data stored in CSV, JSON, ORC, Avro, or Parquet formats

cards.description: Serverless data integration service that makes it easy to discover, prepare, move, and integrate data from multiple sources for analytics, machine learning, and application development.
use_cases: Automated schema discovery and central metadata storage in AWS Glue Data Catalog
Visual and code-based ETL data transformation jobs powered by Apache Spark
Data cleaning and normalization pipelines feeding S3 data lakes and Redshift

cards.description: Cloud big data platform for processing vast amounts of data quickly and cost-effectively using open source tools like Apache Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Presto, and HBase.
use_cases: Large-scale big data processing and transformations on petabyte datasets
Distributed machine learning model training using Apache Spark MLlib
Financial risk modeling and genomic data sequence analysis

cards.description: Scalable and durable real-time data streaming service that continuously captures gigabytes of data per second from hundreds of thousands of sources.
use_cases: Real-time application log and clickstream event ingestion
High-throughput IoT device sensor telemetry streaming
Real-time anomaly detection and fraud analysis pipelines

cards.description: Fully managed service for reliably loading streaming data into data lakes, data stores, and analytics services like Amazon S3, Redshift, and OpenSearch without custom code.
use_cases: Streaming real-time server logs directly into Amazon S3 with automated format conversion (to Parquet)
Continuous ingestion of event streams into Amazon OpenSearch for live dashboards
Real-time micro-batch data ingestion into Amazon Redshift data warehouses

cards.back: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka
cards.full_name: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka
cards.description: Fully managed service that makes it easy for you to build and run applications that use Apache Kafka to process streaming data without managing Kafka infrastructure.
use_cases: Running enterprise Kafka streaming applications with native AWS IAM and VPC security
Event-sourcing architectures with strict partitioning and ordering guarantees
Streaming change data capture (CDC) pipelines between microservices

cards.description: Managed service that makes it easy to deploy, operate, and scale OpenSearch (and legacy Elasticsearch) clusters for interactive log analytics, real-time application monitoring, and search.
use_cases: Full-text search engines for e-commerce product catalogs and enterprise search
Real-time application log indexing and visualization via OpenSearch Dashboards
Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) log analytics

cards.description: Operations hub for AWS and hybrid cloud that provides a unified user interface to view operational data from multiple AWS services and automate operational tasks.
use_cases: Secure interactive shell access to EC2 instances without opening SSH ports via Session Manager
Centralized configuration parameter and secret storage via SSM Parameter Store
Automated patch management and software inventory across hybrid server fleets

cards.description: Service that enables you to assess, audit, and evaluate the configurations of your AWS resources continuously, tracking changes against defined compliance rules.
use_cases: Auditing compliance with security baselines (e.g., verifying all S3 buckets block public access)
Tracking complete configuration history and resource relationships for change management
Automated remediation of non-compliant resources (e.g., auto-enabling encryption)

cards.description: Network transit hub that connects thousands of Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) and on-premises networks through a central hub, eliminating complex peering relationships.
use_cases: Centralizing network connectivity across hundreds of corporate AWS accounts and VPCs
Simplifying hub-and-spoke connectivity between cloud environments and on-premises data centers
Routing all outbound internet traffic through centralized security inspection VPCs

cards.description: Cloud service solution that makes it easy to establish a dedicated, private network connection from your premises to AWS, bypassing the public internet.
use_cases: High-bandwidth, low-latency private connectivity for hybrid enterprise workloads
Transferring massive datasets (terabytes to petabytes) reliably and cost-effectively
Complying with strict regulatory requirements mandating private, non-internet transport

cards.description: Managed service that enables instances in a private subnet to connect to the internet or other AWS services, but prevents the internet from initiating a connection with those instances.
use_cases: Allowing backend database and application servers in private subnets to download OS security patches
Outbound API calls to external third-party payment gateways from private compute instances
High-availability managed NAT across multiple Availability Zones without managing EC2 NAT instances

cards.description: Horizontally scaled, redundant, and highly available VPC component that allows communication between your VPC and the internet with no availability risks or bandwidth constraints.
use_cases: Providing internet access to public subnets and public load balancers
Performing IPv4 network address translation (NAT) for instances with public IP addresses
Enabling direct bidirectional IPv6 communication with the global internet

cards.description: The VPN concentrator on the Amazon side of the Site-to-Site VPN connection attached to your VPC to route traffic between your VPC and on-premises networks.
use_cases: Terminating IPsec Site-to-Site VPN tunnels from corporate branch offices to a VPC
Attaching to AWS Direct Connect private virtual interfaces for on-premises connectivity
Enabling encrypted hybrid cloud data communication

cards.description: An AWS resource that provides information to AWS about your customer gateway device, which is a physical device or software application on your side of a Site-to-Site VPN connection.
use_cases: Registering corporate on-premises firewall or router IP addresses in AWS for VPN peering
Configuring BGP dynamic routing between on-premises routers and AWS VPCs
Establishing redundant VPN connections across dual on-premises hardware routers

cards.description: Static, public IPv4 address designed for dynamic cloud computing that you can allocate to your account and quickly remap to any instance or network interface in your VPC.
use_cases: Maintaining a consistent public IP address for allowlisting by external partner firewalls
Rapid failover masking instance failures by immediately remapping the public IP to a standby instance
Providing fixed egress IP addresses for NAT Gateways

cards.description: Logical networking component in a VPC that represents a virtual network card with private and public IP addresses, MAC address, and attached security groups.
use_cases: Creating multi-homed EC2 instances connected to multiple subnets or security tiers
Attaching dedicated management network interfaces to virtual firewall appliances
Preserving IP configurations during high-availability standby failover events

cards.description: Cloud service that makes it easy to migrate relational databases, data warehouses, NoSQL databases, and other types of data stores to AWS with minimal application downtime.
use_cases: Migrating on-premises Oracle and SQL Server databases to Amazon Aurora with continuous replication
Heterogeneous database migrations converting schemas using AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT)
Continuous Change Data Capture (CDC) streaming database transactions into Amazon S3 data lakes

cards.description: Platform as a Service (PaaS) for deploying and scaling web applications and services developed with Java, .NET, PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Go, and Docker on familiar servers.
use_cases: Rapidly deploying web applications by simply uploading code while AWS handles capacity, load balancing, and scaling
Running standard Docker containers with zero infrastructure management overhead
Automated blue/green deployment orchestration for production web apps

cards.description: Serverless compute engine for containers that works with both Amazon ECS and Amazon EKS, removing the need to provision, configure, or scale clusters of virtual machines.
use_cases: Running containerized microservices without managing EC2 instance infrastructure
On-demand batch container workloads with instant compute provisioning and per-second billing
Isolating container workloads in dedicated kernel-level security boundaries

cards.description: Data security and data privacy service that uses machine learning and pattern matching to discover and protect sensitive data (PII, credentials, financial records) in Amazon S3.
use_cases: Scanning petabytes of S3 bucket data for unencrypted Personally Identifiable Information (PII)
Identifying inadvertently publicly accessible S3 buckets containing sensitive customer data
Automating compliance verification for GDPR, HIPAA, and financial regulations

cards.description: Visual tool that enables you to view and analyze your AWS costs and usage over time, build customized reports, and forecast future cloud spending.
use_cases: Analyzing monthly cloud spending trends broken down by service, region, and custom cost allocation tags
Forecasting future infrastructure expenses for corporate budget planning
Identifying underutilized resources and evaluating Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage

cards.description: Networking service that improves the availability and performance of applications with local or global users using AWS's global network infrastructure and Anycast IP addresses.
use_cases: Accelerating TCP and UDP traffic for multiplayer gaming and live media feeds globally
Instant failover routing traffic between multi-region endpoints in under 30 seconds
Providing static Anycast IP addresses to prevent DNS caching issues on client devices

cards.description: Fully managed ledger database providing a transparent, immutable, and cryptographically verifiable transaction log owned by a central trusted authority.
use_cases: Tracking complete immutable financial transaction histories with cryptographic verification
Supply chain provenance tracking recording full history of custody changes
Regulatory compliance systems requiring tamper-proof audit trails
